x: Charlie Warren, an old-time walker from Erith, sends his best wishes to all his Belgrave acquaintances. Harold King, a former Club and Kent County Walking Champion, has had an operation on his eyes (cataract).

Here he also found many members, some of whom were helping at this meeting. Amongst these were Charlie Warren, Harold King, T. Moore, Jacques and Luther, all of whom sent their best wishes to THE Club.

Askew and C. Warren were reported, this part of an Annual General Meeting always strikes a sombre note, contributing to the history of the Club as it does by the passing of the torch of the Belgrave Harriers ideals from the Elder Belgravian to the young Belgravian.

Fastest: 1 C.Warren (Birchfield) 17:31; 2 A.Jones (Salford) 17:34; 3 N.Anderson (Aldershot) 17:59; =4 J.Trapmore (Shaftesbury Barnet) and G.Raven (Sale) 18:06; 6 D.Deed (Bedford) 18:08; 9 M.Dent (Belgrave) 18:28.
